title: Kalkstein-Klippen-Ecke A
description: Geschichtete L-förmige Kalkstein-Klippen-Ecke (~44 × 36 × 25 m) als 0-Credit-Kitbash aus cliff_chalk_wall_a und cliff_chalk_wall_b mit großzügigem Ecküberlapp, waagrechten Sedimentbänken und senkrechten Zerklüftungen. Farbe canyon_chalk #BCB296, Rauheit ≥ 0,68, 2,5 m Eingrabe-Rand.

review.notes: Cohesive 41.8x40.7x24.4m L-shaped chalk headland combining cliff_chalk_wall_a/b with clean ~10m corner overlap, seamless lower-front cavity heal, #BCB296 canyon_chalk with crisp flint-grey strata and vertical fissures, zero vertical UV stretching, min_z=-2.5 verified, clean wire/clay and bakeable [30000,10000,3000] LODs.
